arxiv-2606-16114: In graph theory, a Hamiltonian graph contains a loop that visits every point exactly once. arxiv-2606-16214: Deep learning models should know when they are unsure, but Bayesian uncertainty methods are usually slow — they need many samples. arxiv-2606-16814: When trains run late, dispatchers must reschedule fast. This paper tackles train rescheduling with a MaxSAT-DDD approach: encoding the problem as a maximum-satisfiability puzzle, using precedence propagation and hybrid search. It is for rail planners. Late trains, swift new plans.
